Use the approved brand book, the actual vial and logo artwork, the current service descriptions and verified business facts (KMD Group LLC dba KMD Analytical, 9631 Topanga Canyon Pl, Chatsworth, CA 91311, kmdanalytical.com once confirmed canonical). First search for an existing Reddit listing and give me candidate URLs and why they match; do not assume no result means no account. I will open Reddit, confirm ownership, and claim, recover or create it. Then draft every field within Reddit's current limits: name, categories, description, services, website and contact links, address, hours, photos and call to action where supported. Leave missing facts as questions. Suggest image sizes for the real logo and banner. No invented accreditation, FDA registration, rankings, review counts, turnaround promises or medical claims. Verify who controls u/Kmd-Analytical and record recovery details in the register. Align artwork to the brand book; no promotional posting until Kevin approves a plan. Finish with a paste-ready field checklist, link-test checklist, verification steps, and a one-line status for the profile register: URL, handle, admin, recovery contact, status, evidence, next step (no passwords).
